messages.subject: Re: Error in measurementInvarianceCat: Some variables in your model are not identified as categorical
parts: When I attempt to test for mi when a composite indicator is included, this error emerges.

This function is only for reflective indicators.  Arguably, formative "measurement" is not measurement at all, but that is an area of much philosophical debate:

http://dx.doi.org/10.1080/15366367.2015.1016343

http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.jom.2016.05.002
